contentText:
But are you in good hands? | Image: Allstate

On Monday, November 23rd, Allstate began dealing with a n outage that has impacted its website, mobile apps, and roadside assistance service. It's just the latest company, including Microsoft and JPMorgan Chase, to suffer an outage in the last few weeks. As of Friday afternoon, access to accounts through the app and site appeared to still be down. When asked for comment, the company pointed us to a notice on its site reading:

Allstate customers can reach us in many ways, including online, by phone and through local offices. Some access has been restricted over the last 48 hours, but we continue to be available for customers and respond to a …

Read the full story at The Verge.
